title: Income-tax Act — Section 80DDB (Deduction in respect of medical treatment of specified disease)

content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80DDB: Deduction in respect of medical treatment of specified disease. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
